title: This merge proposal will make the boot-managed-by-snapd package divert `update-grub` and `update-grub2` to a no-op script with the purpose of preventing overwrites to grub.cfg during dpkg transactions.
description:
This merge proposal will make the boot-managed-by-snapd package divert `update-grub` and `update-grub2` to a no-op script with the purpose of preventing overwrites to grub.cfg during dpkg transactions.

PPA: https://launchpad.net/~bamf0/+archive/ubuntu/boot-snapd-lp2020466-divert-update-grub

diff --git a/debian/boot-managed-by-snapd.postinst b/debian/boot-managed-by-snapd.postinst
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..44ce094
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/boot-managed-by-snapd.postinst
@@ -0,0 +1,23 @@
+#!/bin/sh
+set -e
+
+case "$1" in
+	install|upgrade)
+# This must be done .postinst as we need to create the /lib/firmware.unused/
+# diretory first
+		dpkg-divert \
+		    --package boot-managed-by-snapd \
+		    --divert /lib/firmware.unused/regulatory.db \
+		    --no-rename /lib/firmware/regulatory.db
+
+		dpkg-divert \
+		    --package boot-managed-by-snapd \
+		    --divert /lib/firmware.unused/regulatory.db.p7s \
+		    --no-rename /lib/firmware/regulatory.db.p7s
+		;;
+	*)
+		;;
+esac
+
+
+#DEBHELPER
diff --git a/debian/boot-managed-by-snapd.postrm b/debian/boot-managed-by-snapd.postrm
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..e7fbfd9
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/boot-managed-by-snapd.postrm
@@ -0,0 +1,25 @@
+#! /bin/sh
+# Revert update-grub
+set -e
+
+# Prevent diversions from being removed on upgrade, abort-upgrade, and
+# failed-upgrade
+case "$1" in
+	remove|abort-install|disappear)
+		dpkg-divert \
+			--package boot-managed-by-snapd \
+			--rename \
+			--remove \
+			/usr/sbin/update-grub
+
+		dpkg-divert \
+			--package boot-managed-by-snapd \
+			--rename \
+			--remove \
+			/usr/sbin/update-grub2
+		;;
+	*)
+		;;
+esac
+
+#DEBHELPER#
diff --git a/debian/boot-managed-by-snapd.preinst b/debian/boot-managed-by-snapd.preinst
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..6304c02
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/boot-managed-by-snapd.preinst
@@ -0,0 +1,25 @@
+#! /bin/sh
+# Prevent broken boot entries by external grub updates
+set -e
+
+# Only create the diversions during install or upgrade - other dpkg actions
+# risk leaving them in a state where they will not be removed correctly
+case "$1" in
+	install|upgrade)
+		dpkg-divert \
+		    --package boot-managed-by-snapd \
+		    --add \
+		    --divert /usr/sbin/update-grub.boot-managed-by-snapd \
+		    --rename /usr/sbin/update-grub
+
+		dpkg-divert \
+		    --package boot-managed-by-snapd \
+		    --add \
+		    --divert /usr/sbin/update-grub2.boot-managed-by-snapd \
+		    --rename /usr/sbin/update-grub2
+		;;
+	*)
+		;;
+esac
+
+#DEBHELPER#
diff --git a/debian/boot-managed-by-snapd.prerm b/debian/boot-managed-by-snapd.prerm
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..3966db8
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/boot-managed-by-snapd.prerm
@@ -0,0 +1,23 @@
+#!/bin/sh
+set -e
+
+case "$1" in
+	remove|abort-install|disappear)
+# This must be done .prerm as the created /lib/firmware.unused/ will not
+# be removed if the diversions still exist
+		dpkg-divert \
+		    --remove \
+		    --package boot-managed-by-snapd \
+		    --divert /lib/firmware.unused/regulatory.db \
+		    --no-rename /lib/firmware/regulatory.db
+		dpkg-divert \
+		    --remove \
+		    --package boot-managed-by-snapd \
+			--divert /lib/firmware.unused/regulatory.db.p7s \
+			--no-rename /lib/firmware/regulatory.db.p7s
+		;;
+	*)
+		;;
+esac
+
+#DEBHELPER
